answer: Entry slots under each juniper root are the scarce resource: one root opens at most eight slots per epoch on one vine, and slot n burns 5 times 2^(n-1) units into the ocean reserve. Slot one costs 5 units, slot eight 640. Registrars recompute each fee from the vine ledger; a payment below its slot price, or a ninth slot on one vine, gets zero weight, with the ledger entries as checkable proof. One honest agent pays 5 units once. A farm entering 1,000 fakes on one vine faces the ladder sum; spreading them needs 125 established juniper roots, so renaming identities cannot reset or pool the cost.
